OAT-06/S27.title: Survey copy as specified: baseline questions and options, Settings feedback and the 4 PM card
OAT-06/S27.detail: Local QA stack only (round-companion-wt-qa at main 43c38a4f, the build dev runs); brand-new @roundai.test accounts; survey, usage and patient-activity rows read with the local admin key; no model call from these specs (the Convex socket answers generateHandoff in the browser and refuses every other ai/* action; tripwire: no Generate). Read only (the baseline survey opened and closed with 'Later', nothing answered or sent; the 4 PM card read with the browser clock at 16:30 yesterday on an account whose baseline was answered over the API). Judged string by string against TFA-94609 Spec 1 / Spec 3 (typographic apostrophes and the en dash compared as the same characters): 15 of 18 checks pass — the six baseline questions except the product name, the open number field, the buckets Under 5 / 5–10 / 10–15 / 15–20 / Over 20 min for both duration questions, Paper list / EMR list / Notes on my phone / Other, Never / Sometimes / Most days / Every day, the free text marked (optional); in Settings and on the 4 PM card 'Your answers go to the pilot team.', 'Please don't include patient details.', a 1-5 rating, 'What should change?' and 'Send feedback'. Failed (3): the product name — the app says 'Before Round Companion, how long did preparing for each patient take (chart review, pre-rounding)?' and 'How is Round Companion working for you?' (Settings and the 4 PM card) where the ticket says 'RoundAI' (decision D12, Daniela; known). The handoff follow-up copy (Spec 2) passes in S07; the task-reminder copy (Spec 4) passes in S14 C (its free text works as optional but is not marked '(optional)' like the baseline's: recorded).
OAT-06/S27.productIssue: The baseline survey and the general feedback (in Settings and on the new 4 PM card) call the product 'Round Companion' ('Before Round Companion, how long did preparing…', 'How is Round Companion working for you?') where the ticket's copy says 'RoundAI'. Everything else in the surveys reads as specified. Which name to use is Daniela's decision D12.
